entry_points.text: Early-boot seeding and SNP jump-table lookup run during init, while capability queries avoid instrumentation for safe use in sensitive contexts.
Top-to-fourth-level walk derives the index by shifting and masking the address and the base from the top entry frame via the direct map, reusing the top pointer when five-level paging is disabled.

Fault lookup resolves a faulting address to its instrumentation record by obtaining mapping level, aligning down, selecting the per-address list and scanning under read-side protection for an identical aligned address.
Global invalidation uses hardware broadcast when supported, otherwise requests every processor to run a local invalidation routine.

exports.text: CC capability query dispatches to AMD or Intel helpers by vendor state; paired mutators update only host SNP state on AMD.
Encrypted and decrypted address transforms set or clear a shared mask by vendor and virtual-top mode, else identity.
IO mapping offers encrypted mapping via a common caller-tracked path with validation and memtype reservation, plus identity-map cache sync and virtual-range cache-mode dispatch.
Page-table inspection resolves a virtual address to its mapping entry, reporting level and accumulated attributes toward the leaf.
Hardware random service retrieves longs with bounded retries and a multi-long variant gated on CPU feature enablement.
MMIO probe service installs a probe for a range, failing on aligned-base overlap or missing table entry.
Memory-type tracking reserves and releases caching mode for a physical interval, bypassing when disabled or exempt.
Single-address invalidation offers kernel and user variants, with kernel accounting locally and deferring cross-address work when isolated.

hazards.text: System aborts when hardware randomness yields no longs in a confidential guest; mappings return null for invalid, RAM or exhausted cases with once warnings for RAM remap and multi-BAR coverage; probe install fails on duplicates or missing entries; SNP jump lookup returns zero with error log when secrets mapping fails.

Empty or wrapped ranges, mixed RAM and non-RAM spans, unmatched frees and conflicting overlaps fail; RAM fails busy on non-default pages and invalid for one protection request, one uncached flavour is silently demoted, and non-RAM allocation can fail.

Top-level empty always reports present without five-level paging so cannot gate table release; isolated kernel single-flush only marks deferred cross-address work; frame masks differ for leaf versus table; double arming warns yet proceeds, clearing fails without a mapping or on unexpected levels, and restore assumes a prior clear.

Flush paths require enabled interrupts except early boot, skip cache work when caching bits are untouched, fall back to full flush without line-flush support or when forced by size or error with ordered per-page loops; callers must align addresses with truncation warning, stale mappings are purged first, and uncached uses the weaker minus variant.

Bringup defaults set CS, DS, LDTR, GDTR, IDTR and TR limits to 0xffff, RFLAGS 0x2, DR6 0xffff0ff0, XCR0 0x1, page attribute table 0x0007040600070406, x87 tag 0x5555, x87 control 0x0040, CR0 0x60000010, MXCSR 0x1f80; status bits map to labels for SEV, SEV-ES, SEV-SNP, vTom, ReflectVC, RI, AI, DebugSwap, NoHostIBS, BTBIsol, VmplSSS, SecureTSC, VMGExitParam, IBSVirt, VMSARegProt, SMTProt, SecureAVIC and IBPBOnEntry.
Routed fragments depend on external helpers for logging, locking, lists, allocation, address translation and warnings, owned outside this dossier and not specified here.

invariants.text: Intel affirms unrolled string IO and guest and global memory encryption; AMD in virtual-top mode affirms only guest and global encryption, otherwise SME mask drives memory encryption, host needs mask without SEV, guest needs SEV, guest state needs SEV-ES, SNP and secure TSC and secure AVIC follow status bits, host SNP follows software flag, string IO needs SEV without SEV-ES.

Encryption sets the mask in AMD classic mode but clears it in AMD virtual-top and Intel modes with decryption inverted; early seeding runs only under guest memory encryption, filling a fixed buffer, aborting on no progress, then mixing and erasing it.

Common remap rejects zero size, wrap, invalid address and RAM, aligns and strips tag bits, reserves memtype and reconciles cache mode with unwind on failure; protection starts from a kernel IO default, encrypts on collected or explicit demand, layers cache bits except writeback, forbids promotion from weaker modes, and adds encryption only for private MMIO and selected runtime EFI data under guest encryption.

Address lookup descends four levels folding execute and writability, stopping on empty, leaf or non-present; level size is two to a shift stepping per level from page shift, with mask as negated size minus one.

Entry assessment treats empty as zero raw ignoring an erratum mask, present as present or protection-none or page-size, leaf as large-page indication; flag and frame split uses the matching mask, top-level empty is forced present without five-level paging, and five-level enablement is constant false on 32-bit or a variable or feature query on 64-bit.

Directory values preserve frame while sanitising protection with protection-none correction; native and paravirtualised constructors, readers, stores, atomic leaf stores and clears share logical effect with a fast path when virtualisation is absent; helpers translate entries to pages and rebuild entries from frame plus protection.

Reservation sanitises bounds with exclusive-end adjustment, rejects empties, bypasses with effective mode when disabled or exempt, folds a firmware hint demoting one mode, branches to per-page RAM versus interval allocation, and logs with readable mode names.

RAM classification skips the low legacy range and walks system RAM reporting RAM, mixed or none; RAM reservation rejects one protection mode, demotes strong uncached with a once warning, fails busy unless every page is default cached, then stamps the mode while release resets to default, with one build in page flags via compare-exchange and the other using a sentinel.

Non-RAM tracking uses an ordered interval store: insert checks conflicts requiring uniform type across overlaps and adopts consensus type, erase removes only an exactly equal entry, with trivial builds when disabled.

Attribute change resolves page-pointer arrays to zero for high memory else direct addresses, address arrays by index and contiguous ranges by stride with sign normalisation; cache decoding treats an empty field as default else folds three flag bits into an index, inverse of mode-to-protection encoding, with uncached requests using the weaker minus variant.

Large-page restoration needs large-page support, alignment, no forced-small marker, present subentries with identical flags and consecutive frames, plus gigapage support for the largest size; promotion relocates the small attribute bit to the large position and marks large, with counters updated only when enabled and valid.

Broadcast and sync helpers have active and inert builds; active broadcast checks alignment, active sync forbids migration and repeats on erratum; range cache flush aligns to line size and steps with runtime-patched instructions fenced by patched barriers.

MMIO trace checks an atomic enable flag, logs, applies an optional physical filter, then links state; fault-page arming reuses entries by reference count and arms on zero-to-one transition else allocates with count one into a hashed bucket; feature test returns zero for compile-disabled bits, warning emits once with taint, and memory set spans builtin, wrapper and fast-string assembly forms.

locks.text: Trace installation holds a dedicated trace lock while revalidating enablement and linking before probe registration; probe registration holds interrupt-save plus a dedicated fault lock while checking duplicates and arming.

One spin lock serialises non-RAM interval tracking across conflict check plus insert and across exact-match removal, releasing on success and failure with candidate freed on failure; per-page RAM stamping takes no such lock.

Attribute walks serialise each step with a dedicated lock under read protection of the address space, collapse uses write protection plus attribute and top-level locks while scanning, and broadcast invalidation holds preemption disabled across broadcast and sync.

state_machines.text: Vendor selection starts at none, steering queries, transforms and flag updates into AMD, Intel or neutral absent, identity and no-operation responses.
Hardware random retrieval retries the instruction up to a fixed count, succeeding early on carry and failing only after exhaustion.
Paging level advances from largest to smallest coverage as descent succeeds, with size, shift and mask derived arithmetically from level identity.

Instrumentation record starts unarmed; arming warns if already armed yet continues, clears present state saving prior value, flushes one kernel translation, then marks armed; clearing supports only middle and leaf granularities with save paired to a later restore.

Attribute change canonicalises masks and exits when idle, aligns down with warning, purges stale and alias mappings, walks each address merging set and clear masks with flush only on actual change, preserves or splits large entries on demand, and selects translation versus cache flushing from what changed.

Large-mapping restoration visits array entries or aligned blocks, rebuilds mid-size mappings when subentries agree then attempts larger rebuilds, flushes once on any change, and releases retired tables distinguishing accounted and non-accounted pages.

structs.text: Compact 64-bit flag container with a single host SNP bit plus reserved space, instantiated once as global mutable state.

SEV state holds read-only-after-init scalars for hypervisor features, secrets location, TSC scale, offset and frequency, privilege level and communication-block version, plus per-CPU pointers to runtime data and save areas.

Instrumentation fault record carries aligned address, armed flag, reference count, saved presence and chaining; interval record carries inclusive start, exclusive end and caching mode; transient scan state carries start frame plus RAM indicator.

Symbolic contract defines leaf versus middle level identifiers, present, large-page and erratum-mask indications, frame-versus-flag and physical-address masks, a small caching-mode enumeration with readable and fallback names, three-bit cache-index assembly, small-to-large attribute relocation, and prefixed gated logging.
